description: Read recent published archive records when you want a chronological overview without a search term. Returns count, stories, the feed receipt, and release identity; each story retains sources, evidence clocks, publication state, release IDs, and limitations. Public and read-only; no sign-in. Lists default to 10 records, at most 20, without pagination. The canonical feed is cached for up to 60 seconds; unavailable or invalid feeds return a tool error.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, newest first; 1 to 20, default 10. There is no pagination parameter.

name: latest_stories

outputSchema.description: Published archive records with a feed receipt and deployed MCP release identity. Evidence dates describe the source record; fetched_at describes retrieval, not market freshness.

count.description: Number of records returned, not the total number of matches.

feed.description: Canonical feed URL, content hash, item count, publication authority, and retrieval timestamp.

release.description: MCP version and deployed source SHA, when available.

stories.description: Newest-first published records retaining stable IDs, source links, evidence clocks, publication state, release IDs, and limitations.

title: Read the latest evidence-bounded stories
